rows.grounds: liṅgāt (abl. sg. of liṅga) + hasta-śatam (hundred cubits, acc. sg. measure); L1/L2: extent measured from the liṅga
kṣetram (acc. sg., field/sacred area) + ācārya-sthāpite (loc. sg., established by the teacher); L1/L2: when the liṅga is installed by the teacher
loc. sg. pres. part. of √as (sat); L1/L2: conditional/locative absolute context, 'when it is so'
loc. sg. of svayambhūta (self-born/self-manifested liṅga); L1/L2: contrasted case of a self-manifested liṅga
acc. sg. numeral/measure; L1/L2: extent of a thousand (cubits) in the self-manifested case
indeclinable particle of contrast; L1/L2: marks contrast between the two cases
tad-ardham (half of that, acc. sg.) + ṛṣi-yojite (loc. sg., installed by a sage/ṛṣi); L1/L2: when installed by a sage, the extent is half of that
